about: Placeholders for every image that is in the game now with no art of its own (GPT-PROMPTS-2026-11-16-nine-doors.md). tools/art/make_placeholders.py reads this list and writes each file (SVG; a PNG where the build needs a raster), and the catalog entry under `catalog` / `id` with `placeholder: true`. The artist's delivery replaces the entry by id (its `final` path); `slot: true` means a screen draws it today, `slot: false` that no screen has a slot yet. `tint` is a key of art/style-guide/palette.json attributes (its ui_ink), or muted / white / neutral.
